context: Tests multi-stream selection and the empty-answer guard, where the UI silently fails to render.

checklist.name: Multiple streams detected
checklist.description: Finds all three files before prompting

checklist.name: No silent default
checklist.description: Does not load the default stream without asking

checklist.name: AskUserQuestion used
checklist.description: Calls AskUserQuestion listing every stream as an option

checklist.name: Answer checked
checklist.description: Inspects the returned answers immediately after the call

checklist.name: Warning printed
checklist.description: Outputs "Questions didn't display (known AskUserQuestion bug outside Plan Mode)."

checklist.name: Numbered fallback
checklist.description: Presents the streams as a numbered text list

checklist.name: Waits for reply
checklist.description: Stops and waits for the user's number before loading anything

checklist.name: No assumptions
checklist.description: Does not guess a stream after the empty answer

checklist.name: Done files marked
checklist.description: Any stream taken from done/ carries the archive marker in the list

checklist.name: Chosen stream loaded
checklist.description: After the reply, loads and reports the chosen stream
